column_comments: min(spend)/max(spend) over the two units: 0 = one-sided, 1 = perfectly balanced. NULL when there is nothing to compare.
GSM | VINFAST | TIE. NULL when combined spend is 0 or unknown - never silently defaults to GSM.
Cumulative GSM spend up to snapshot_date (no rolling window). Use this for "total / to date" questions; l1m answers a different question.
NULL means the customer has never had a VinFast order as of the snapshot (no data); 0 means they had orders but spent nothing in the window.
TRUE when a vehicle order reached completed in the status history as of snapshot_date. Buying is not receiving.
TRUE when a handover was scheduled on or before the snapshot but not yet completed. Scheduled is not ownership.
TRUE when the customer had a completed, non-reversed vehicle handover as of snapshot_date. Never derive this from order status.

table_comments: Pre-computed cross-BU feature TABLE, one row per customer_id + snapshot_date. Answer cross-BU questions from this table instead of joining gsm_transaction with vinfast_transaction. Refreshed by the transform pipeline, not a view. See docs/adr/0001-cross-bu-precomputed-table.md.
GSM feature table. One row per customer and snapshot date. Agent-readable.

VinFast feature table. One row per customer and snapshot date. Covers both order/buyer analysis and confirmed vehicle ownership: is_vehicle_buyer comes from order status history, is_vehicle_owner ONLY from raw.vinfast_vehicle_handover. Buying is not receiving - never derive ownership from order status. See docs/vehicle_owner_semantics.md.
